study: long-only weekly cross-sectional REVERSAL and LOW VOLATILITY over xsmom's point-in-time top-30 Binance USDT universe (delisted pairs included) — the second search on that universe; six pre-registered candidates judged by xsmom's bar against its turnover- and exposure-matched random-selection null; combined with the live Revolut X row trend-4h
bar: a candidate passes when its out-of-sample return is positive on BOTH windows A and B, AND its worst window of A–D is above the 95th percentile (s[floor(0.95·n)], n = 1000) of its matched null's worst window. §4.15's 35 % drawdown limit is reported beside it. (xsmom's bar, unchanged.)

definitions.rebalance: weekly: decide on Sunday's close (UTC), fill at Monday's open; each run also forms on its first day

signals.reversal: the trailing L-day return close(d)/close(d−L) − 1 at the decision close; the k LOWEST are held, ties by symbol
signals.lowVolatility: the sample standard deviation (n − 1) of the 30 simple daily returns close(t)/close(t−1) − 1, t = d−29 … d; the k LOWEST are held, ties by symbol
signals.regimeFilter: xsmom's: the whole book is cash while BTCUSDT's close is below its 200-day mean at the decision
signals.weights: each holding at 1/k of equity; no absolute filter
